[[File:Stony brook athletics wordmark.png|thumb|250x250px|Stony Brook Seawolves primary logo]]
The '''Stony Brook Seawolves men's basketball statistical leaders''' are individual statistical leaders of the [[Stony Brook Seawolves men's basketball]] program in various categories, including [[Point (basketball)|points]], [[Assist (basketball)|assists]], [[Block (basketball)|blocks]], [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]], and [[Steal (basketball)|steals]]. Within those areas, the lists identify single-game, single-season, and career leaders.<ref name="MG">{{Cite web|title=Stony Brook Division I Record Book|url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/sidearm.sites/stonybrook.sidearmsports.com/documents/2018/5/1/Division_I_Record_Book.pdf}}</ref> The Seawolves represent [[Stony Brook University]] in the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] [[NCAA Division I|Division I]] [[Colonial Athletic Association]].

Stony Brook played its first Division I season in 1999.<ref name="MG" /> These lists are updated through the end of the [[2021–22 Stony Brook Seawolves men's basketball team|2021–22]] season.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Stony Brook Leaders & Records - Season|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/stony-brook/leaders-and-records.html|access-date=2022-02-17|website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com|language=en}}</ref>
